tasks.goal: Make spec runner show test steps clearly — dry-run prints the plan for human review, live execution prints and checks milestones as they complete.

context.problem: Current dry-run only prints 'Resolved spec X to replay Y'. Users can't review what the test will do before running it. Live execution streams raw stdout with no step-by-step progress.
context.spec_structure: Specs have structured steps: setup[] → operations[] → assertions[] → cleanup[], each with id, surface, intent. This structure should drive the output.
context.design_approach: Design/implement/test loop: 1) Define step rendering format for dry-run, 2) Define step-event contract for replays, 3) Implement in runner + one replay, 4) Verify with real spec, 5) Roll out to other replays.
context.acceptance_note: Deferred infrastructure improvement. Project completed without this enhancement — runner output was sufficient for verification workflow.
